design.protected_host_policy: Reserve one budget slot for host_merged_cublaslt@merged, then fill by regime_max order; report only shapes with this host measured and stable.
design.quality_rule: Use the unchanged stable subset. Retain and enumerate every excluded candidate; never impute a label.
design.sample_savings: Candidate-label count only, not GPU wall time. Calibration, compilation, prediction, repetition and profiler costs are not measured here.
design.scoring: Minimum observed latency within the proposed shortlist, relative to minimum over the same measured stable candidate set. This is an ideal retrospective shortlist score, not a deployed noisy measurement policy.
design.tie_rule: Candidate identity lexicographic order for exactly equal scores; no measured timing tie-break for model ranking.

evaluation_scope: Ideal shortlist replay on previously inspected development data; measured stable subsets vary by shape.
